children: The Bank of Canada issues more background documents regarding the renewed 2% targeting-framework. In a statement from the BOC's governing council, senior BOC officials reiterate that rate policy is "not the right instrument" to address housing. "While monetary policy can temporarily influence housing demand and prices in the short run, it cannot resolve long-run structural supply constraints to improve" housing affordability. Housing affordability remains a top priority for policymakers, but homebuilding faces stiff headwinds due to higher costs for material and labor. During a press conference, Macklem says the residential real-estate market has been soft. "It may pick up a little bit, but we're not really expecting a rapid recovery there," Macklem adds.
